changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 2a, item 1: updated to the tightened dreamux-types context contract (activity/logger now required); deleted the dead injectEnv plumbing (R30) from runtime-deps.ts, runtime-session.ts, runtime.ts, provider.ts, and the activity reader; the console-fallback logger gained a child() to keep satisfying the now-required DreamuxLogger.child field. Internal-only; no runtime or published-API change.
